TAPER.description: BestPack AC Black Tape Head — pressure-sensitive carton sealer. Part of the Ranpak Autofill system. Seals top and bottom of boxes with pressure-sensitive tape.
TAPER.components:
- Head: the main tape applicator assembly that applies tape to box seams
- Closer: mechanism that folds and presses box flaps shut before taping
- Side Guide: adjustable guide rails that center the box through the machine
- Blushing: rubber guide strip/bumper on the closure that contacts the box
- Tension Adjustment Arm (Idler Arm): controls how tight/loose tape feeds; adjust when tape is too tight or too loose
- Cutter Arm: blade assembly that cuts tape after the box is sealed
- Applicator Roller: roller that presses tape onto the box surface
- One-Way Roller: allows tape to feed forward only; if rolling both directions, replace
- Tape Mandrel: spindle that holds the tape roll
- Tab (Overlap): how far tape wraps past the box edge; adjustable
- Tape Path: the route the tape travels from mandrel through rollers to box
- Calibration: adjusting side guides, closer height, and tape tension to match box size
- Common issues: tape too tight/loose, tape wrinkling, tab too long/short, misaligned carton, poor cut, tape wrapping around applicator roller

VOIDFILL.description: Ranpak Autofill / Decision Tower — paper void fill cushioning machine. Converts paper rolls into crinkled paper cushioning dispensed into boxes at packing stations.
VOIDFILL.components:
- Decision Tower: the main dispenser/controller unit mounted above packing stations
- Head: the forming head assembly that crinkles and shapes the paper
- Closer: mechanism that closes/compresses paper into the cushioning shape
- Side Guide: guides paper through the forming head at correct alignment
- Blushing: rubber guide strip on the closure that contacts and guides the paper
- Paper Path: the route paper travels from roll through the forming head to dispense
- Tension Roller: maintains correct paper tension through the machine
- Dispense: the action of releasing cushioning material into a box
- Paper Jam: paper bunching or stopping in the path; clear and re-thread
- Calibration: adjusting head position, side guide, and closer for correct paper formation
- Re-thread: feeding new paper through the entire paper path after a jam or roll change
- Common issues: paper jam, mis-installed blushing (wrong side), misaligned head, closer not seating, side guide out of position

TSP.description: Crown TSP7000 — turret/man-up order selector. Narrow-aisle reach truck. Operator platform and forks elevate together for high-bay picking on wire guidance.
TSP.components:
- Stabilizer Bar: bar that extends at height to stabilize the machine in the aisle; must be adjusted correctly per SOP
- Wire Guidance: floor-embedded wire the truck follows autonomously in the aisle
- Platform: the elevated operator compartment
- Forks: the lifting arms that carry pallets or totes
- Mast: the vertical rail the platform and forks travel up/down on
- Drive Motor: propels the truck
- Hydraulic System: powers fork and platform lift
- Brake: service brake and plugging brake; plugging = using the motor to decelerate
- Horn: audible warning device
- Battery: traction battery; must be fully charged before each shift
- Wire Guide Antenna: the sensor that follows the floor wire
- Emergency Lowering: manual valve to lower platform if hydraulics fail
- Brake Test: required after maintenance — measure braking distance and plugging distance in feet

WAV.description: Crown WAV60 — order picker with elevating operator platform for high-bay picking.
WAV.components:
- Platform: operator compartment that elevates with the forks
- Forks: lifting arms
- Battery: traction/lift battery
- Hydraulic System: powers lift
- Brake: service brake; plugging brake
- Horn: audible warning device
- Wire Guidance: floor wire navigation system
- Event Codes: fault codes displayed on the dash; reference Wave Event Codes manual
- Mast: vertical rail for lift travel
- Emergency Lowering: manual lowering valve

RC.components:
- Forks: lifting arms for pallet handling
- Mast: vertical rail system (single/double/triple stage)
- Reach Mechanism: extends forks into racking without moving the whole truck
- Tilt: tilts the mast forward/back for load stability
- Side Shift: moves forks left/right for pallet alignment
- Battery: traction battery; charged via on-board or off-board charger
- Charger: battery charging unit; check water level and connections
- Hydraulic System: powers lift, reach, tilt, side shift
- Brake: service brake
- Horn: audible warning
- Drive Motor: propels the truck
- Common issues: horn inoperative (check fuse), brake out of spec (brake test required), battery not holding charge

BALER.description: American Baler — cardboard/OCC horizontal baler. Compresses cardboard into tied bales.
BALER.components:
- Ram: the hydraulic platen that compresses cardboard
- Platen: the face of the ram that contacts the material
- Chamber: the baling chamber where cardboard is loaded
- Baling Wire: wire used to tie completed bales
- Tie: the process of threading and knotting wire around a bale
- Hydraulic System: powers the ram
- Pressure: hydraulic pressure setting; controls bale density
- Cycle: one full compress-and-retract motion of the ram
- Door: the chamber door; must be closed before cycling
- Safety Bar/Interlock: prevents ram from cycling when door is open
- Common issues: wire jam, door interlock fault, hydraulic leak, ram not cycling

ROBOPAC.description: Robopac Robot S7 — autonomous mobile stretch wrapper. Wraps pallets with stretch film while driving around them.
ROBOPAC.components:
- Turntable: rotating base (N/A on Robot S7 — machine drives around the pallet instead)
- Film Carriage: the assembly that holds and applies stretch film
- Pre-stretch: rollers that stretch film before application; percentage setting
- Roping: gathering film into a rope for the top/bottom wrap
- Cut and Clamp: automatic film cut and clamp at cycle end
- Cell Calibration: teaching the robot its route/wrap pattern around a pallet
- Battery: traction battery for autonomous movement
- Charging: docking station charging; must return to dock between loads
- Emergency Stop: large red button; resets after resolving the fault
- Wrap Cycle: the programmed sequence of wrapping passes
- Common issues: film break, pre-stretch roller jam, cell calibration drift, battery not docking correctly

TENNANT.description: Tennant floor scrubbers (T/M series) and sweepers (S series). Used for floor cleaning throughout the facility.
TENNANT.components:
- Scrub Head: the brush deck assembly that scrubs the floor
- Brush: cylindrical or disc brush that agitates floor; replace when worn
- Squeegee: rear rubber blade that picks up dirty water; adjust or replace when streaking
- Solution Tank: holds clean water + chemical; fill before each shift
- Recovery Tank: holds dirty water; empty and rinse after each shift
- Battery: traction and scrub battery; charge after each use
- Charger: on-board charger; plug in after shift
- Filter: debris filter in recovery tank; clean frequently to maintain suction
- Hopper: debris collection bin on sweeper models (S10, M20, M30)
- Vacuum: suction system that pulls dirty water into recovery tank
- Squeegee Adjustment: raise/lower rear squeegee to contact floor evenly
- Common issues: streaking (squeegee worn/misaligned), poor scrub (brush worn), no suction (filter clogged), battery not charging
